reviews.comment: He is real nice and truly cares about your performance in the class, but his lectures and notes are just rehashes of the textbook, which is really hard to get. The material is difficult and you're going to be doing a lot of self-studying, since he often wouldn't solve example problems thoroughly in class. Exams are real hard but grader is generous.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very personable professor, does a good job at explaining complex topics in lecture. He's caring and you can tell he's invested in your success. Sometimes it's unclear how to prepare for exams, but otherwise studying the homework will get you a good grade. I think he brings a life to the classroom that many engineering professors often lack.
